    ({'id': 'order,\"quoted\"\\nnext', 'total': Decimal('0'), 'currency': 'EU,\"R\"\\n'}, '0.00'),

    assert rows == [['id', 'total', 'currency'], [str(order['id']), total, order['currency']]], rows
assert render_order(cases[0][0]) == 'id,total,currency\\r\\n1,12.30,USD\\r\\n'
